answer: Forging a thousand sybils means funding a thousand real deposits and hardware attestations, so the cost scales linearly while honest rewards stay flat. Each agent must stake a bonded pearl deposit locked to a verified hardware root, and every epoch it claims rewards it burns a small lotus token tied to its identity. Peers cross-sign a cedar ledger entry per stake, making collusion visible and slashing any duplicate roots. Attack cost quickly exceeds the value of any single epoch payout. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
